main_options.title: Main options
main_options.description: Most common options used for the pipeline

mode.title: Analysis Mode
mode.description: R&D mode is for flexibility and testing, while HT mode prioritizes performance and scalability.

duplex_seq.title: Enable when the input is duplex sequenecing.
duplex_seq.help_text: With this parameter flags in various tools are set for duplex sequencing data.

read_structure.title: Read structure
read_structure.description: fgbio read structure for samplesheet rows that leave Read Structure blank, with one segment per FASTQ file, such as 6M+T 6M+T for 6 bp inline UMIs at the start of both reads. See https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/fgbio/wiki/Read-Structures

grouping.title: Read grouping options
grouping.description: Options for when grouping reads by UMI

groupreadsbyumi_edits.title: Maximum number of edits
groupreadsbyumi_edits.description: Maximum number of allowable edits for fgbio's GroupReadsByUmi.

consensus_calling.title: Consensus reads options
consensus_calling.description: Options for when creating consensus reads

call_min_reads.title: Minimum reads to call a consensus
call_min_reads.description: The minimum reads to call a consensus for fgbio's CallMolecularConsensusReads/CallDuplexConsensusReads.

call_min_baseq.title: Minimum input base quality
call_min_baseq.description: The minimum input base quality to use when calling a consensus for fgbio's CallMolecularConsensusReads/CallDuplexConsensusReads.

consensus_filtering.title: Consensus filtering options
consensus_filtering.description: Options for when filtering consensus reads

filter_min_reads.title: Minimum reads to keep a consensus
filter_min_reads.description: The minimum reads to keep a consensus for fgbio's FilterConsensusReads.

filter_min_baseq.title: Minimum consensus base quality
filter_min_baseq.description: The minimum consensus base quality to keep when calling a consensus for fgbio's FilterConsensusReads.

filter_max_base_error_rate.title: The maximum error rate for a single consensus base
filter_max_base_error_rate.description: The maximum error rate for a single consensus base when filtering a consensus for fgbio's FilterConsensusReads.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per sequencing run of a sample, with its FASTQ files in order. Put a UMI index read (I1 or I2) in FASTQ 3 or FASTQ 4. Rows with the same sample, such as one per lane, are merged by the pipeline, and must have the same number of FASTQ files and the same read structure.

sample.title: Sample
sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.title: FASTQ (R1)
fastq_1.errorMessage: Must be a read FASTQ (.fq, .fastq, .fq.gz or .fastq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read

fastq_2.title: FASTQ (R2)
fastq_2.errorMessage: Must be a read FASTQ (.fq, .fastq, .fq.gz or .fastq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read

fastq_3.title: FASTQ 3 (e.g. I1)
fastq_3.description: Third FASTQ file, such as an index read holding the UMI. Leave blank if there is none
fastq_3.errorMessage: Must be a FASTQ (.fq, .fastq, .fq.gz or .fastq.gz) with no spaces in its name

fastq_4.title: FASTQ 4 (e.g. I2)
fastq_4.description: Fourth FASTQ file, such as a second index read. Leave blank if there is none
fastq_4.errorMessage: Must be a FASTQ (.fq, .fastq, .fq.gz or .fastq.gz) with no spaces in its name

read_structure.title: Read Structure
read_structure.description: fgbio read structure with one segment per FASTQ file, in column order (e.g. 6M+T 6M+T, or +T +T 8M for a UMI in FASTQ 3). Leave blank to use the read structure set in the form
